values.note: 2026 rates: water/electric $50 a day ($68 holiday, $300 a week, $900 a month), full hookup $63 ($82 holiday, $380 a week); rustic sites along the Tyler Creek Trout Trail $33 ($47 holiday). Cabins $185-205. Overnight visitors $6 a person a night, day visitors $2. A deposit is due at booking ($50 for a daily campsite stay; a holiday stay is paid in full).

fees.source: https://www.tylercreekgolfandcamp.com/camping/rates-booking/ ('2026 Rates' table: Rustic $33 daily / $47 holiday; Water/Electric Standard $50 / $68; Full Hook-Up Standard $63 / $82), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reservations by phone (leave a message for the manager at (616) 868-6751) or email; no online booking. 'Cabin and weekend camping reservations require a 2-night minimum stay. Holiday weekend reservations require a 3-night minimum stay.'

booking.source: https://www.tylercreekgolfandcamp.com/camping/rates-booking/ ('We are accepting reservations via phone and email at this time'; minimum-stay lines under the rate table), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.tylercreekgolfandcamp.com/camping/ ('sites with water & electric for RV's and Full hook-up sites as well') + rates page (Full Hook-Up Standard), read 2026-10-22. facilities.source: https://www.tylercreekgolfandcamp.com/ ('Onsite Laundry', 'Wifi in the Clubhouse', '30,000 Gallon Heated Swimming Pool') + campground map (shower, dump-station and camp-store symbols), read 2026-10-22

note: Private 9-hole golf course and campground along Tyler Creek, a designated cold-water trout stream, in Alto ESE of Grand Rapids. Seasonal lots (signed lease, management approval of the RV) sit alongside the nightly sites; the park does not say how many of its 200 lots are seasonal. --Claude
summary: Operator's 2026 rate table: water/electric $50 (base), full hookup $63, holiday $68/$82, rustic $33; phone/email booking only with a 2-night weekend and 3-night holiday minimum (recorded). Confirmed water/sewer, 200 lots, showers/dump/laundry/store. Cleared directory-only 50-amp, 40-ft max and pull-through values. Season not stated by the operator (winter storage Nov 1 - Apr 14 implies it), left alone. Note cleaned (prices, hookups and booking moved to fields; the location was wrong: Alto is ESE of Grand Rapids, not W).
flags: Long-stay check: the park sells seasonal lots under a signed lease and its about page stresses families who 'return year after year', but it publishes no seasonal count, so the seasonal share is unknown. It passes the five tests as published: nightly rate posted ($50 water/electric, at the US$50 line and not over; Grand Rapids metro gateway 32 km anyway), nights sold by phone/email with no application, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimum only, and no count to fail test 4.

Waterfront re-audit lead: entry is 'not waterfront', but the operator says the course and campground are 'set along a beautiful Pure Michigan trout stream' and offers 'primitive sites along the Tyler Creek Trout Trail'; the campground map draws the rustic loop (sites 1-27) beside the creek. Whether any RV site is on the creek is not stated.
